values.subject: Qichen Cloud June-December 2025 withholding summary
values.body_text:
This is your June-December 2025 salary-withholding summary. The special additional deduction began at Qichen Cloud after the September system migration and was not duplicated here in June-August.
If the tax application shows both employers claiming the same monthly deduction, review it in the application; neither employer should confirm the annual settlement for you.
